one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: Manufacturer, distributor and marketer of polyurethane (PU) foam, mattresses and other home comfort products for Indian consumers.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: Sham Foam Limited is a vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane (PU) foam, mattresses, pillows, cushions and other home comfort products, sold under the Featherfresh and Restivia brands. It also manufactures industrial-grade PU Foam used in furniture, sports products, seat covers, shoes, innerwear, jackets and related apparel, distributed through a pan-India dealer network.

group_structure.title: Group structure (subsidiaries / JV / related parties)
group_structure.body:
- Aggarwal Comforts Private Limited — Entity in which KMP/relatives are interested: recurring sales counterparty per related-party disclosure
- Charming Fashions Private Limited — Corporate Promoter / entity in which KMP interested: sales, share issuance and borrowings counterparty
- Omesha Infraprojects LLP — Entity in which KMP/relatives are interested
- Sukh Sampada builders LLP — Entity in which KMP/relatives are interested

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:
- **Mattresses:** Featherfresh range, Restivia range, pure foam mattresses, hybrid spring/rebounded-foam mattresses
- **Pillows & Cushions:** Featherfresh pillows, furniture cushions, cushions
- **PU Foam (Industrial):** customised-density PU Foam cores, sheets for job-work finished products

end_markets.title: End Markets (RHP)
end_markets.body:
- mattress and furniture industry
- sports products
- seat covers
- shoes
- innerwear, jackets and related apparel

certifications.title: Certs (RHP)
certifications.body:
- ISO 9001:2015
- BIS Certification No. IS 7933:2022 (quality management systems)

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Full-stack vertically integrated manufacturer: sources principal raw materials (TDI, polyols, catalysts, additives) from local and overseas (Hong Kong, Thailand, Singapore) suppliers at monthly-reset prices with 50-70 day supplier credit; manufactures PU Foam in-house via a continuous foaming line (raw-material mixing, foam forming/settling, curing for at least 12 hours, cutting) at its own facility; combines cut foam with spring/rubberised coir and processes into finished mattresses/cushions in-house; certain finished products such as pillows are outsourced on a job-work basis to third-party manufacturers; distributes exclusively through a pan-India dealer network (no owned retail stores) and also sells PU Foam grades directly to third-party manufacturers of furniture, sports products, seat covers, shoes and apparel.

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- EBITDA margin expanded from 1.68% (FY23) to 6.01% (FY24) to 5.78% (FY25) to 10.74% (H1FY26), reflecting operating leverage
- PAT margin rose from 0.87% (FY23) to 4.02% (FY24) to 4.41% (FY25) to 8.43% (H1FY26)
- Revenue from operations growth has been volatile: +13.33% (FY23), -7.63% (FY24), +10.06% (FY25)

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Expand customer base geographically and demographically
- Deepen presence in existing 13-state footprint and penetrate the broader domestic market
- Continue to pursue cost efficiency and economies of scale in procurement
- Attract, train and retain skilled workforce
- Develop personalised, customised home-comfort product lines to improve operating margins
- Maintain consistent quality standards in PU Foam manufacturing

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: No new plant is being added; Net Proceeds are earmarked for civil construction and purchase of machinery/equipment at the EXISTING Ambala (Haryana) manufacturing facility to expand/upgrade capacity, alongside working-capital funding. Growth strategy otherwise centers on deepening penetration within the existing 13-state footprint and entering new geographies with scaled, low-price offerings rather than physical capacity addition disclosed in this bundle.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Promoter and employee industry experience in the foam business since inception
- In-house, technology-driven manufacturing facility (ISO 9001:2015, BIS IS 7933:2022) with QR-code product traceability and warranty registration
- Extensive pan-India sales and distribution network spanning 13 states with 1,300+ dealers
- Long-standing dealer relationships despite no long-term contractual agreements
- Focus on quality control and timely delivery

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- No long-term dealer/customer contracts — Company generally does not enter into long-term agreements with its ~1,300 dealers/customers, so relationships (and revenue) rest on continuity of goodwill rather than contractual commitment
- State-level revenue concentration — Punjab, Uttar Pradesh, Haryana and Delhi together accounted for ~71% of FY25 revenue from operations, with Punjab alone at 27.37%
- Single-site manufacturing concentration — All PU Foam production runs from one facility in Ambala, Haryana (15,000 TPA); any disruption there affects the whole business
- Imported raw-material dependence — Key inputs TDI and polyols are sourced from overseas suppliers in Hong Kong, Thailand and Singapore at monthly-reset prices, exposing margins to forex and import-price volatility
- Related-party transaction exposure — Recurring sales, borrowings, remuneration and rent transactions with promoter-owned/-interested entities (Aggarwal Comforts, Charming Fashions, Omesha Infraprojects LLP, Sukh Sampada Builders LLP) create potential conflict-of-interest exposure
- Volatile revenue growth — Revenue from operations growth swung from +13.33% (FY23) to -7.63% (FY24) to +10.06% (FY25), indicating limited growth predictability

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Company intends to utilise up to Rs. 1,371.65 lakhs of Net Proceeds to finance capital expenditure for civil construction and purchase of machinery/equipment at its existing manufacturing facility.**
- **Company intends to utilise up to Rs. 1,425.00 lakhs of Net Proceeds to part-finance its working capital requirements.**
- **General corporate purposes utilisation from Net Proceeds is capped at the lower of 15% of gross proceeds or Rs. 1,000.00 lakhs.**
- **Company intends to widen its customer base geographically and demographically while deepening relationships with existing customers.**
- **Company plans to deepen presence in its existing 13-state market and penetrate the larger domestic market with scaled, low-price offerings to grow market share.**
- **Company intends to keep improving operational effectiveness at its production facility to reduce costs and expand profit margins.**
- **Company aims to manufacture higher volumes of customised products and develop new personalised home-comfort product lines to further improve operating margins.**

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Expand customer base geographically and demographically
- Deepen presence in existing 13-state footprint and penetrate the broader domestic market
- Continue to pursue cost efficiency and economies of scale in procurement
- Attract, train and retain skilled workforce
- Develop personalised, customised home-comfort product lines to improve operating margins
- Maintain consistent quality standards in PU Foam manufacturing
